name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
eligibility_summary: For eligible older persons in Below Poverty Line households; state implementation and pension amount can vary.
where_to_start: Gram Panchayat, municipal office, or Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
